description: This file defines the TextGrid class, which provides methods to render a text-based grid representation of a matrix, including headers, rows, and footers, with support for CLI and HTML output.

classes.name: TextGrid
classes.description: A helper class for rendering a matrix as a formatted text grid, supporting CLI and HTML output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TextGrid with a matrix and output mode (CLI or HTML).

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates and returns the string representation of the text grid.

methods.name: renderRows
methods.description: Renders all rows of the matrix into the grid display.

methods.name: renderCells
methods.description: Renders individual cells within a row.

methods.name: renderColumnHeader
methods.description: Renders the header row with column references.

methods.name: renderFooter
methods.description: Renders the footer line of the grid.

methods.name: getColumnWidths
methods.description: Calculates the width of each column based on cell content.

methods.name: getColumnWidth
methods.description: Determines the maximum width needed for a column.
